fullDaySay: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 60s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 50s returns with water: +3 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 30s and A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid are comparing scars like trading cards.
A person, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
A man, maybe 50s traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Carmela and Ernestine lingered over the fire together.
Colin and Ernestine lingered over the fire together.
Liam and Linh lingered over the fire together.
Chloe and Luis lingered over the fire together.
You remember the Hatchet at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Canvas Pants at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
📓 Journal: the man in his 40s, with a crooked nose taught the man in his 50s Food Preservation.
📓 Journal: the person in their 50s, with a slouched posture taught the woman in her 30s, with a buzz cut Animal Behavior.
🤒 Marelize is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
Oliver sits with Marelize — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 the man in his 40s, with a crooked nose, the dentist pronounced a Denver place-name the way someone reads it off a map for the first time. Nobody from there says it that way.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose).

🔥 Wanjiru has been turning something over all evening. Finally: “Chloe. The story about what you’re after — we all eat from the same pot here, we don’t get to lie about who’s at it.” It costs Wanjiru to say it; you can see the price land.
“You’re right.” Chloe doesn’t look up. “I wasn’t belong. I was family. I’m sorry — I wanted a cleaner story than I had.” The fire lets it land. Someone passes Chloe the bowl without a word.
People bring you their suspicions, written down. You keep every one.
A person, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A woman, maybe 50s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Luis," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Luis." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Luis).
"Ernestine," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ernestine." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ernestine).
"Carmela," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Carmela." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Carmela).
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You take 4 logs from the woodpile for the road home. (10 left for the hearth.)
You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
A person, maybe 30s will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ernestine — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Colin," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Colin." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Colin).

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 9 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ernestine telling A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut telling A man, maybe 40s, with a long braid about A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Deep shade. The floor keeps its secrets.
Journal updated: a vine with thick-skinned round fruit grows here too — better than a thorny bush with dark berries.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND **Green Thumb, Literally**. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown berries, 3× unknown shoots. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Colin picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
Colin picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
You break ground behind the hall — bed 3 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 4 of 4, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You catch fragments by the fire — Carmela telling A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
🪤 A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose is back from the snares: +330 kcal to the pantry.
💧 Luis returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with restless hands returns with water: +4 clean.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1230 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose passes around a slender fast-growing tree with feathery leaves and long hanging pods. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
★ IDENTIFIED: Moringa. Feathery leaves, long pods. The leaves are food — fresh or dried. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Moringa too.

A man, maybe 40s, with a crooked nose spends the afternoon with the vine with thick-skinned round fruit — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Muscadine Grapes — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Muscadine Grapes. Muscadine. Thick-skinned wild grapes. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Muscadine Grapes. The vine with thick-skinned round fruit you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
Colin was watching. Now they know Muscadine Grapes too.
🔍 A crouches over feathery fern-like leaves, flat-topped white flower clusters, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan came back with 224 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 112 kcal in, 112 kcal eaten at the fire.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Linh and Carmela lingered over the fire together.
Wanjiru and Ernestine lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Oliver leaves the surplus by the fire for whoever's hungry. "The pantry can't take it. We can."

Fresh-cut stems on the northwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (Stonebridge's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
— DAY 4 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, unknown shoots went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Moringa — named and noted.
👀 Someone asks Ernestine a shop-talk question about doctor work. The pause before the answer is long enough to hear.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (Ernestine).
🔥 “I don’t say this lightly.” Ernestine sets their bowl down. “Liam, your trade story isn’t true, is it? I’ve heard enough versions now.” Nobody looks at Liam. Everybody does.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ernestine — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Oliver," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Oliver." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Oliver).
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
Walking 4 squares (8 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Movement — a box turtle, ancient and unhurried.
👁 Slow. Walk up and pick it up. That's the whole hunt.
You catch fragments by the fire — Colin telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a gap-toothed grin about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
A hollow log big enough to crawl into. You don't crawl in. You note where it is, in case the weather ever makes the offer again.
Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
Movement — a crow watching you from a dead branch, head cocked.
👁 It sees you before you see it, and it tells everyone. Take the shot before the cawing starts — after that, the whole woods knows where you're standing.
Unfamiliar unknown shoots — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
You work the patch: 5× Muscadine Grapes — and 4× unknown shoots you can't name yet. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
You keep a day's food (450 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
1 unprocessed haul onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 5 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Colin picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
Colin picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
You sow Muscadine Grapes: 365 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 45 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
You sow Muscadine Grapes: 365 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 45 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ernestine — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Marelize," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Marelize." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Marelize).
Walking 4 squares (8 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
You catch fragments by the fire — Carmela telling A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan about Ernestine. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
Something pads into the clearing — a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something. It's here.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
A kingfisher works the far bank, patient as a tax collector. It catches something silver and is gone before you can envy it properly.
It followed you. The raccoon with too many fingers is here.
Movement — a bluegill nosing around a shallow bed.
👁 It won't leave its bed — that's the whole trick. Pressed, it darts to the center and waits. Reach down and take it, or fish the bed with a worm.
✅ You saw the creek. A person, maybe 30s nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The raccoon with too many fingers stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
While you were gone — one thing you missed:
⚔️ Farid stood down the dog-shaped silence at the treeline and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
You walk back into Haven. 6 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
Ernestine will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
📋 A woman, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Ernestine — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Farid," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Farid." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Farid).

Farid leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something. Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Journal: Counter: Buy it off — It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase.
Walking 4 squares (8 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
